description: This file implements the TpmAttestationRecordContext class and related functions for managing TPM attestation records, including device ID verification, key generation, and boot state management within the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: TpmAttestationRecordContext
classes.description: Class managing TPM attestation records, including device IDs, boot parameters, and attestation keys.

methods.name: MakeVbParams
methods.description: Creates and initializes VerifiedBootParams with default values.

methods.name: TpmAttestationRecordContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the context with default boot parameters and a random unique ID key.

methods.name: GetSecurityLevel
methods.description: Returns the security level of the context, set to trusted environment.

methods.name: matchAttestationId
methods.description: Compares a blob with an ID vector for equality.

methods.name: VerifyAndCopyDeviceIds
methods.description: Verifies device IDs against stored IDs and copies them if matching.

methods.name: GenerateUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID based on provided parameters.

methods.name: GetVerifiedBootParams
methods.description: Returns the current verified boot parameters.

methods.name: GetAttestationKey
methods.description: Retrieves the attestation key for a specified algorithm.

methods.name: SetVerifiedBootInfo
methods.description: Sets the verified boot state, bootloader state, and digest.

methods.name: SetAttestationIds
methods.description: Sets device attestation IDs from a request.

methods.name: SetAttestationIdsKM3
methods.description: Sets device attestation IDs for KM3 from a request.
